latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Editor PC — cloud AI video editing for PC users.

- Upload raw video (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB), give editing instructions, and download a 1080p MP4—no need for manual controls.
- One-click setup: Anonymous token and session management handled automatically; clear status updates as you connect.
- Supports editing, cutting, transitions, text, audio tracks, and batch processing using simple natural language commands.
- Cloud GPU rendering pipeline: Fast 30–90s exports; all processing occurs remotely.
- Robust error handling covers tokens, credits, formats, and rate limits.
- Designed for easy, fast edits—no experience with tools like Premiere required.
